product.title: CRBN² TruFoam Barrage (Square)
product.body_html:
Relentless by Design

The CRBN TruFoam™ Barrage is built for players who want power that shows up instantly. Using the same 100% TruFoam™ Gen-4 foam core technology that defines Genesis and Waves, Barrage introduces a new core architecture engineered specifically for pop-based power. The result is a paddle that delivers immediate explosion on contact, faster ball speed, and relentless pressure in every exchange.

Designed for players who attack early, speed the game up, and finish points decisively, Barrage turns quick swings into clean winners while maintaining the stability and consistency the TruFoam family is known for.

Whether you thrive in hands battles, punish high balls, or rely on fast counters and drives, Barrage is designed to keep your opponents on their heels.

What to Expect When First Trying Barrage

From your first hit, Barrage feels fast and alive. The response off the face is immediate, with a crisp pop that rewards quick acceleration and confident swings. There is no lag and no delay. The ball jumps off the paddle with purpose.

At the heart of Barrage is a proprietary floating foam core that sits within an EVA foam perimeter ring. This construction stabilizes the paddle, increases perimeter weighting, and expands the effective sweet spot. You get explosive pop without the unpredictable feedback that often comes with high-power paddles.

The result is a paddle that feels controlled even when you swing hard. Quick volleys feel sharp and decisive. Counters come off clean. Drives stay on line.

Why Choose Barrage?

Instant Pop and Explosive Power

Barrage is built for pop-based power. Its floating foam core is tuned to return energy immediately, creating a fast, responsive feel that shines in hands battles, speed-ups, and aggressive drives. Power is available the moment you swing, without extra load time.

Stability Where It Matters Most

The EVA foam perimeter ring adds structure and perimeter weighting, increasing torsional stability and enlarging the sweet spot. Off-center hits stay controlled and predictable, even at high swing speeds. This stability allows you to attack confidently without sacrificing consistency.

Consistent Performance That Lasts

Like Genesis and Waves, Barrage eliminates core crush and break-down found in older gen paddles. The high-density TruFoam™ core provides longevity in performance that you will not find with honeycomb.

Spin You Can Trust

Spin is generated through TruFoam’s internal dynamics rather than surface grit alone. This means your spin remains reliable and repeatable over time, even as traditional surface textures wear down. Shape the ball with confidence on drives, rolls, and counters.

One Thickness. No Compromises.

Barrage is engineered at 14mm to deliver the ideal balance of power, stability, and feel. TruFoam™ technology removes the need to choose between thickness options. You get a paddle tuned for modern, fast-paced pickleball without trade-offs.

Premium Carbon Face

Barrage features CRBN’s signature T700 raw carbon fiber face to handle the demands of high-impact play. Our proprietary layup configuration, enhances responsiveness while maintaining strength, spin, and control under aggressive swings.

The CRBN Advantage

CRBN Pickleball, based in Costa Mesa, California, is built by players who demand more from their gear. Barrage is the result of extensive prototyping and a ground-up rethink of how foam-core power should feel for fast, aggressive play.

The CRBN TruFoam™ Barrage is not just powerful. It is precise, stable, and relentless.

CRBN TruFoam™ Barrage. Relentless by Design.
